'''Maven's Punishment''' [[debuff]] applies -10% to max elemental [[resistances]], and disables life and energy shield [[recovery]] for 10 seconds.

[[The Maven]]'s rotating beams apply this debuff.

The Uber variant of [[The Maven]] applies this debuff with Tri-Beam Claw attack in addition to applying it with the rotating beams.

[[Category:Debuffs]]
